model_selection: Evaluate both fixed Step 3 families; no winner or hyperparameter selected from test outcomes.
intervals: Paired ordinary customer bootstrap, fixed recommendations, percentile pointwise 95 percent intervals; no multiplicity correction.
training_resampling: Bootstrap within action arms only, same samples for both model families; score fixed evaluation customers and hold policy tie seed constant.
random_baselines: Average 100 seeded random rankings; both email types share selected customers. Report allocation variation separately.
cluster_selection: k in 2,3,4,5; maximize development-attribute silhouette among minimum-size >=5 percent and mean bootstrap ARI >=0.75; mark fallback if none eligible.
cluster_ablation: Development folds only; fit fresh clustering on each fold training rows; compare logistic uplift with and without one-hot cluster membership.
genai: Grounded draft messages and explicit content audit only; no conversion lift claim. No second email is authorized by a single-contact policy.
